say:1:1410731001:0.text: Indris, I ask you, what is your choice?
say:1:1410731001:0.source_cn: 因度厄，告诉我，你的抉择是什么？

say:5:1410731003:0.text: Don't hesitate. Accept Her Majesty's guidance and favor. Just like I did years ago...
say:5:1410731003:0.source_cn: 不必犹豫，接受女王陛下的指引吧。如同当年的我……

say:7:1410731005:0.text: Yes, I, too, delved into the mystery of the Divine Dew, questioning its nature and the path Her Majesty chose to follow.
say:7:1410731005:0.source_cn: 我也曾独自探寻恩典灵露的真相，我也曾质疑女王陛下做出的选择。

say:8:1410731006:0.text: The path you are walking now is a path I have walked before.
say:8:1410731006:0.source_cn: 你现在走过的路，我也曾踏上。

say:9:1410731007:1.text: But you still chose to cover up the truth with the queen?!
say:9:1410731007:1.source_cn: 但你仍然选择和女王他们一起掩盖真相？！

say:10:1410731008:0.text: Cover up? No... When I witnessed the truth of the forbidden land and endured the pain of the curse, I realized that the path Her Majesty chose is the only one that offers any glimmer of hope.
say:10:1410731008:0.source_cn: 掩盖？不，当亲自见到禁地的真相，亲身体会了诅咒的痛苦，...

say:11:1410731009:0.text: Indris... When I look at you, I am reminded of the days when I, too, was impulsive and blind, believing that revealing the truth could somehow set everything right.
say:11:1410731009:0.source_cn: 因度厄……看着你，我会想起曾经的自己也如此冲动天真。自...

say:12:1410731010:0.text: However, in the face of this despairing truth, the Essail have no other path forward. To avoid succumbing to our tragic fate, we can only choose this path, even if it's cruel.
say:12:1410731010:0.source_cn: 然而在绝望的真相面前，艾塞勒没有别的路可走。为了不臣服...

say:13:1410731011:0.text: There is no shame in survival. Ignorance is a kindness.
say:13:1410731011:0.source_cn: 求生并不可耻。愚昧才是仁慈。

say:14:1410731012:0.text: In time, you will understand. With boundless mercy, Her Majesty forgave my past arrogance. I can only hope she grants you the same grace, Indris.
say:14:1410731012:0.source_cn: 你会理解的。女王陛下以她的慈悲宽宥了僭越独行的我，希望...

say:16:1410731013:0.text: Thador, the past need not be revisited. Your loyalty was proven long ago.
say:16:1410731013:0.source_cn: 都铎，不用记挂那些小小过失了，你早已向我展现了自己的忠诚。

say:18:1410731014:0.text: I'm grateful for your boundless patience and understanding.

say:20:1410731015:0.text: Indris… Drink the Divine Dew and submit to my rule. Do so, and I shall grant you the power to defy fate.
say:20:1410731015:0.source_cn: 因度厄……饮下恩典灵露，臣服于我的统治。我将赐予你对抗...

say:22:1410731016:0.text: Forgive me for being so blunt, Your Majesty, but I would rather face this curse than pay such a price for survival.
say:22:1410731016:0.source_cn: ……恕我直言，陛下。我宁愿直面诅咒，也不愿用如此代价换...

say:24:1410731017:0.text: Your courage is commendable, but it is wasted on reckless foolishness.

say:25:1410731018:0.text: Who gave you this courage? Was it you there, mage from the surface?
say:25:1410731018:0.source_cn: 是谁给予了你这份勇气，是那位来自异族的魔法师吗？
say:25:1410731018:0.male: Who gave you this courage? Was it you there, mage from the surface?
say:25:1410731018:0.female: Who gave you this courage? Was it you there, mage from the surface?

say:30:1410731021:0.text: An outsider dares to think he can save the Essail clan on mere chance? Who's to say your actions didn't just delay his transformation?

say:30:1410731021:0.female: An outsider dares to think she can save the Essail clan on mere chance? Who's to say your actions didn't just delay his transformation?

say:31:1410731022:0.text: I have struggled against this curse for thousands of years, only to see more of my people succumb to its corruption.
say:31:1410731022:0.source_cn: 千年间我一直在尝试破除诅咒，每次研究都造成更多的同胞孽化。

say:32:1410731023:0.text: Do you truly think I have not tried other means? Every lesser approach led only to tragedy.
say:32:1410731023:0.source_cn: 你以为我没有尝试过其他方法吗？所有温和的方案都以惨剧告终。

say:33:1410731024:0.text: Those who stood by my side, the Essail who knew the truth, chose to carry this secret to their graves.
say:33:1410731024:0.source_cn: 那些与我同行的人，那些知晓真相的艾塞勒，他们都选择将这...

say:34:1410731025:0.text: It is the path we have all chosen.
say:34:1410731025:0.source_cn: 这不是巧合，这是所有人的共识。

say:35:1410731026:0.text: If you genuinely wish to aid us, then accept reality. Here in Sal'thorin, survival is the only justice.
say:35:1410731026:0.source_cn: 如果你真的想帮助我们，就接受现实吧。在萨洛克兰，生存才...

say:37:1410731027:0.text: But the Sylvan Tendril really works! Feli...
say:37:1410731027:0.source_cn: 但织叶确实有效！斐利尔——

say:39:1410731028:0.text: Enough! Did you witness the curse being undone with your own eyes?
say:39:1410731028:0.source_cn: 够了！你亲眼见到了孽化解除吗？

say:43:1410731030:0.text: I saw it! I can prove it!

say:45:1410731031:0.text: Indris, would you truly cast aside the way that has sustained our people for thousands of years on the words of outsiders?
say:45:1410731031:0.source_cn: 因度厄，你要因为外来者的一面之词，否定千年来维系我族生...

say:47:1410731032:1.text: Your Majesty, the people have the right to know the truth. There's still hope.
say:47:1410731032:1.source_cn: 陛下，民众有知晓真相的权利。新的希望已然出现——

say:52:1410731034:1.text: Ah, I finally understand! The Divine Dew is her means of controlling Sal'thorin. She won't ever give it up!
say:52:1410731034:1.source_cn: 我算是明白了，恩典灵露现在可是她控制萨洛克兰的手段，她...

choice_prompt:53:1410731034.text: Ah, I finally understand! The Divine Dew is her means of controlling Sal'thorin. She won't ever give it up!
choice_prompt:53:1410731034.source_cn: 我算是明白了，恩典灵露现在可是她控制萨洛克兰的手段，她才不会放弃呢！

say:57:1410731037:0.text: It appears I must guide you once more.
say:57:1410731037:0.source_cn: 看来，是时候再度引领你们了……

choice:53:0:1.text: Words can only take you so far...
choice:53:0:1.male: Words can only take you so far...
choice:53:0:1.female: Words can only take you so far...

choice:53:1:2.text: I'll fight for what I believe in.
choice:53:1:2.male: I'll fight for what I believe in.
choice:53:1:2.female: I'll fight for what I believe in.

choice:26:0:1.text: Yes, he knows I have his back.
choice:26:0:1.male: Yes, he knows I have his back.
choice:26:0:1.female: Yes, he knows I have his back.

choice:26:1:2.text: I was able to lift Feli's curse.
